notes.title: Foto Flash 2 is Coming!
notes.notes:
Hey ho there,

Daner here with some exciting news. Foto Flash 2 is coming out in two weeks and has a store page!

If you're into what you see, you can wishlist and follow the game. It really helps us with visibility.

We're working very hard on it day and night to make sure that it's even better than the first one!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/861760/Foto_Flash_2/

notes.title: Screenshots Fix
notes.notes:
Hey there,

Daner here with a very quick update. I finally got around to fixing Steam screenshots. So you can now happily F12 all day long :)

I also fixed some bugs related to dialogue sequences not firing properly.

I'm still busy working on translations and other bug fixes on Foto Flash, as well as a sequel coming out in a few months. But I'll have more to say on that in a few weeks.

Hope you're having a great summer!
Daner

notes.title: New Time Trial Mode!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's Daner here back with another update!

Foto Flash now features a brand new time trial mode. Collect clocks around Sala City to extend your time and complete the game before it runs out to get a new bonus illustration and unlock an achievement.

Here's a list of changes in the update:
[list]
[*]Added new time trial mode accessible from the menu
[*]Fixed bugs related to bringing certain items to Cymbelle and the Barista
[*]Misc changes and fixes
[/list]

Also, a french translation is in the works, so francophones can look forward to that!

Finally,  I'm happy to say we've weathered the storm of the previous controversy and Foto Flash will be remaining on the Steam platform unchanged.

Have a great summer!

notes.title: Get Your Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
Howdy!

Today I am pleased to announce that as of today Foto Flash now has trading cards. So that's pretty cool.

So get out there and get your trade on!

notes.title: OST Now Available! (and a few small fixes)
notes.notes:
Hey Y'all,

Daner here. It's a bit later than promised, but you can now get your hands on the Foto Flash OST, completely free!

https://daner.bandcamp.com/album/foto-flash-ost

Along with that there are tiny updates and bug fixes.
[list]
[*]Fixed bug when giving the monkey a banana.
[*]Added menu text to the dialog file
[/list]

That's it for now. I had taken the last week or so off to recharge my batteries, so apologies if I wasn't around much.

The next major update will come in a few months or so. It will add a newgame+ time trial feature and trading cards to the game. So get hyped for that!

Peace and Love!
Daner

notes.title: Update #2 and OST coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey Y'all,

Daner here. I know it's only been a day since the last update, but I fixed some things that will hopefully make some people very happy.

Here's the patch notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a number of collision glitches
[*]Fixed stretching on monitors with non-16:9 monitors.
[*]Controller users now have the option between the d-pad and analog stick to control the player.
[/list]

Also, the official OST will be posted on bandcamp for free later in the week. I'm currently working on extending and remastering the tracks.

Peace and Love!
Daner

notes.title: First Update and Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all,

Daner here. I've been blown away by the support that Foto Flash has gotten in such a short amount of time. From the bottom of my heart, thank you!

Here's the patch notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed as much as possible the black bar graphical glitch seen on lower resolution monitors
[*]Added a return to Main Menu option in-game.
[*]Added extra numbers for the secret achievement.
[*]Added a censor mode that was requested by streamers.
[*]Changed the wall color in the magazine office.
[*]Added a single tree. I refuse to say where.
[/list]
I'm still working on other bugs and issues people have brought up. If you find any other issues, please let me know and I'll try to fix it as soon as possible.

Peace and Love!
Daner

notes.title: Foto Flash is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey hey hey! Welcome everyone!

After a lot of hard work, I'm proud to announce that Foto Flash is out now!

Currently the game is only available in English, but if you would like to make a fan translation, we made the game's dialogue easily accessible in the game's folder. Just give us a shout if you need any help.

If you have a question or a comment, you can head over to the discussions or shoot us a tweet @studiogamaii.

From everyone who worked on Foto Flash, we hope you have a good time!

Peace and Love!
Daner
